The previous attempt was the mistake: it emitted the *Markdown embed* (image tag + source footer) as if that were the `.fd` file itself — hence the parser choking on `![Certificate...` and `<sub>source:...` as unknown keywords. The `.fd` file must contain only FigDown syntax: the spec-provenance comment, the `figdown 0.1 <genre>` line, then the block content. The Markdown embed is a *separate* thing that goes in the host document, referencing this file.

Here is the corrected `cert-renewal.fd`:

```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 block
title "Certificate renewal automation"

block scheduler "Scheduler"
block renewaljob "Renewal Job"
block caclient "CA Client"
block ca "Certificate Authority"
block deployagent "Deploy Agent"
block service "Service"

scheduler -> renewaljob
renewaljob -> caclient
caclient -> ca
renewaljob -> deployagent
deployagent -> service
```

To embed this in a host Markdown document, once built to `figures/cert-renewal.svg`:

```markdown
![Certificate renewal automation: scheduler triggers a renewal job, which asks a CA client to obtain a certificate from the CA, then hands off to a deploy agent that restarts the service](figures/cert-renewal.svg)

<sub>source: [figures/cert-renewal.fd](figures/cert-renewal.fd)</sub>
```

Next step: run `node <skill-dir>/build-svg.js cert-renewal.fd` to validate and produce the SVG, then look at the render to confirm the six blocks and five edges (scheduler→renewaljob, renewaljob→caclient, caclient→ca, renewaljob→deployagent, deployagent→service) match the description before embedding.
